search.name: Mimicry Helper
search.punchline: Automatically mimic the role you're looking for.
search.website_text:
A plugin for FFXIV that helps you find a player to mimic. # MimicryHelper

Use /mimic to open up the menu and click on the appropriate button to automatically mimic the role you're looking for.

You can also type /mimic <d|h|t>.

variant.changelog:
1.0.1.9 (2026.05.12)
- Updated for Dawntrail (7.5) release and Dalamud 15.0.0.
1.0.1.8 (2025.12.21)
- Updated for Dawntrail (7.4) release.
1.0.1.7 (2025.08.09)
- Updated for Dawntrail (7.3) release.
- Fixed scenario where event list would not update until a refresh was forced by changing filter options.
- Fixed a number of typos.
- Migrated from Dalamud Packager to Dalamud.SDK
1.0.1.6 (2025.03.30)
- Updated for Dawntrail (7.2) release.
1.0.1.5 (2024.11.24)
- Updated for Dawntrail (7.1) release.
- Added sorting to the server events.
1.0.1.4 (2024.07.05)
- Typo fixing.
1.0.1.3 (2024.07.02)
- Update for Dawntrail (7.0) release.
- Probably fixed the icon.
- Update to API v10.
1.0.1.2 (2023.01.01)
- Moved to stable plugins from testing
- Removed deprecated PluginLog references.
1.0.1.1 (2023.10.09)
- Updated to Patch 6.5 release.
1.0.1 (2023.08.09)
- Fixed improper icon.
- Added 'add event' and 'report event' links.
